headline: Wave 4 in flight. The course now draws three or four settings per run from a pool of twelve marathon cities, seeded by the date — so every day is a different journey, not just a different layout, and something new arrives roughly every 60 seconds. The renderer is being taught those twelve places now. Landed this wave: the three lanes are three distinct surfaces rather than one flat road, so a hazard's lane can be named from a still frame; ~70% of impassable blocks are now inhabited by a rider or marshals instead of bare barriers; and forced-action gates went from 6% to 38% after the record was called too easy. Outstanding: portrait HUD panels overlap, and the ramp mechanic (vehicles you climb and jump from) is still unbuilt.

pieces.name: Pace & record model
pieces.verdict: projectClean() exact from mile 3; verified vs real runs
pieces.gap: None — in-browser run matches sim to 2s

pieces.name: Course generation
pieces.verdict: 90 dates deterministic and provably solvable; 38% of gates now force an action
pieces.gap: Raised difficulty has not been re-judged by a human since the record was called too easy

pieces.name: Daily settings (12 cities)
pieces.verdict: 3-4 settings per run drawn from twelve; shortest segment 3.93mi over 200 days
pieces.gap: Generated and carried on the course, but the renderer does not draw them yet

pieces.name: Collision & fairness
pieces.verdict: Thresholds fixed; audit gates every screenshot; windows widened to 0.571s / 0.725s

pieces.name: Runner character
pieces.verdict: Slide reads feet-first — the head leaves the silhouette, which was the whole fix
pieces.gap: Human features and secondary motion still in build

pieces.name: Lane individuation
pieces.verdict: Three vertex-tinted lane bands + continuous seams; 147/188/166 value ladder, no draw-call cost
pieces.gap: A full-width gate lays three mats side by side and hides the bands; only the seams carry it

pieces.name: Cel-shading & sky
pieces.verdict: Sky rewritten, colour-space fixed, outlines reweighted to world-space units
pieces.gap: Nothing casts occlusion beyond the contact shadow

pieces.name: World & obstacles
pieces.verdict: Cones, signs, detours, cyclists, marshals; ~70% of blocks inhabited; variant picker is now a real hash
pieces.gap: Mile-gantry occlusion never fixed; crowd still reads as blocks, not people

pieces.name: Ramps & climbable vehicles
pieces.gap: Roof-running needs the solver extended from lane to lane-plus-height

pieces.name: Camera & speed feel
pieces.verdict: Raised above the head so the road ahead is readable; +15% speed reads as +37% screen flow
pieces.gap: Ground frequency, not camera work, is the remaining speed cue

pieces.name: HUD & typography
pieces.verdict: Projected finish leads; exact RECORD GONE bound; numerically precise throughout
pieces.gap: Portrait panels overlap — proj finish, clean gates, mile split and FPS all collide

pieces.name: Aid (water & bananas)
pieces.verdict: One at a time, placed in the hardest legal lane; tops streak to a ceiling, never buys top gear
pieces.gap: None — worthless to a perfect run, a lifeline to a broken one, by design

pieces.name: Controls & game feel
pieces.verdict: Swipe direction corrected; forgiveness windows widened after a 0-clean-gate human run
pieces.gap: Only one human has played it

pieces.name: Audio
pieces.verdict: Procedural mix written, never listened to

pieces.name: Frame rate
pieces.verdict: 5-10fps under SwiftShader software rendering in CI
pieces.gap: Never measured on real hardware with a GPU — the CI number may not mean anything
